s1.syndrome_frame: A middle-aged man with a history of coronary artery disease and emphysema presents with chest pain, respiratory symptoms, and significant weight loss, found to have a mediastinal mass with mass effect on surrounding structures
salient_findings: Spindle cell neoplasm with large nuclei and prominent nucleoli
key_facts: Retrocardiac necrotic mediastinal mass on noncontrast chest CT
Mass effect on esophagus, left atrium, and pulmonary veins
Benign bronchial cells on transbronchial needle aspiration
Spindle cell neoplasm on EUS-guided FNA
Immunohistochemical staining positive for CD117, DOG1, Cam5.2, and AE1/AE3
No mutations in cKIT and PDGFRA

raw.syndrome_frame: A middle-aged man with a history of coronary artery disease and emphysema presents with chest pain, respiratory symptoms, and significant weight loss, found to have a mediastinal mass with mass effect on surrounding structures
salient_findings: Spindle cell neoplasm with large nuclei and prominent nucleoli
key_facts: Retrocardiac necrotic mediastinal mass on noncontrast chest CT
Mass effect on esophagus, left atrium, and pulmonary veins
Benign bronchial cells on transbronchial needle aspiration
Spindle cell neoplasm on EUS-guided FNA
Immunohistochemical staining positive for CD117, DOG1, Cam5.2, and AE1/AE3
No mutations in cKIT and PDGFRA

differentials: Solitary fibrous tumor of the pleura
per_call: Solitary fibrous tumor of the pleura

shortlist.label: Gastrointestinal stromal tumor (GIST)
shortlist.why_kept: Immunohistochemical staining positive for CD117, DOG1, Cam5.2, and AE1/AE3, and germline testing positive for NF1, suggesting wild-type GIST

shortlist.label: Malignant schwannoma
shortlist.why_kept: Spindle cell neoplasm with large nuclei and prominent nucleoli, and presence of a retrocardiac necrotic mediastinal mass

shortlist.label: Thymoma
shortlist.why_kept: Mediastinal mass with mass effect on surrounding structures, and patient's age and sex

shortlist.label: Lymphoma
shortlist.why_kept: Presence of multiple pulmonary nodules, hilar lymph nodes, and a pleural-based lesion on PET imaging

shortlist.label: Sarcoma
shortlist.why_kept: Spindle cell neoplasm and presence of a large mediastinal mass with mass effect on surrounding structures

raw.rationale: The patient's diagnosis is supported by the presence of a spindle cell neoplasm with positive immunohistochemical staining for CD117, DOG1, Cam5.2, and AE1/AE3, and the absence of mutations in cKIT and PDGFRA, which is consistent with a wild-type GIST.

rejected.label: Malignant schwannoma
rejected.why: While it is a type of spindle cell neoplasm, the immunohistochemical staining pattern does not support this diagnosis

rejected.label: Thymoma
rejected.why: The location of the tumor in the retrocardiac mediastinum and the presence of a spindle cell neoplasm do not typically correspond with thymoma

rejected.label: Lymphoma
rejected.why: The normal complete blood count and the specific immunohistochemical staining pattern do not support a diagnosis of lymphoma

rejected.label: Sarcoma
rejected.why: While the patient has a spindle cell neoplasm, the specific immunohistochemical staining pattern and the absence of mutations in cKIT and PDGFRA make GIST a more specific diagnosis
